timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am already bracing for this family gathering.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I keep imagining the comments and questions.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Old roles make it hard to feel like myself.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: Part of me wants to avoid the whole event.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body remembers familiar tension.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I feel pressure to keep everyone comfortable.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am worried I will react or shut down.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that this gathering feels difficult.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I am carrying the whole event before it begins.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can meet one moment at a time.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I do not have to step back into an old role.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Other people's questions do not require every answer.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can pause before I respond.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can remember that I have choices now.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am not responsible for everyone's comfort.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can take space when I need it.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can plan one boundary and one source of support.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can let the gathering become smaller in my mind.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can stay connected to myself around my family.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust myself to choose what I share.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can answer briefly or change the subject.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can notice the people and moments that feel safe.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can remain grounded in the present.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am allowed to leave or take a break if needed.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can be respectful without abandoning my boundaries.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I carry my adult choices into this room.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to meet this gathering on my terms.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
